description: This file defines a base class for all Result classes in a Perl project using DBIx::Class ORM. It sets up components, provides a method to convert objects to hash references, and overrides the has_many relationship method to set default options.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result
classes.description: Base class for all Result classes in the Coocook schema, providing common functionality and component setup.

methods.name: as_hashref
methods.description: Returns a hash reference containing all column values of the object, with optional additional key-value pairs.

methods.name: has_many
methods.description: Overrides the default has_many method to set cascade_copy to false by default and handle argument validation.
